newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia retail sales rise 1.1 pct in August. [corrected 02:36 gmt]
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia retail sales rise 1.1 pct in August. [corrected 02:36 gmt]

text.p: Australian retail sales rose 1.1 percent to A$10.44 billion in August, seasonally adjusted, after rising a revised 1.0 percent to A$10.33 billion in July, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
July was originally reported as a rise of 2.4 percent.
In August 1995, retail sales rose 1.3 percent to A$9.94 billion.
Analysts median expectations had been for sales to fall 1.2 percent in August.
